verdict.rationale: Washington SOS handles user-submitted business, charity and voter data, so a privacy policy on AI-training use of that data is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use restrictions or any opt-out. The documentation covers only filings, searches, certificates, trademarks and related services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
